name: nocache-parameter-recomputes-children
description: nocache sends n-1 and n-2 with the nocache property (cache skipped, result not stored); their own children use the cache again. Cached so far: 0..12. n=16 (miss): 15 [nocache] -> 14 (miss: 13 miss = 0+0+1, 12 hit -> 2) + 13 (hit) + 1 = 3; 14 [nocache] -> 13 hit + 12 hit + 1 = 1; COST = 3 + 1 + 1 = 5.
